fields.description: Azizi Arian is a residential apartment development in the Jebel Ali area, with studios and one- to three-bedroom homes. Its published plans include individual balconies and layouts of different sizes. A cinema, clubhouse and pools form part of the marketed shared facilities.

overview: The branded factsheet places Arian beside Sheikh Zayed Road and metro connections in Jebel Ali’s business district. Its shared facilities include cinema and clubhouse space. Verify actual walking access and the chosen residence’s outlook.
research.locationNote: Branded factsheet describes Jebel Ali and JAFZA; Property Finder labels Downtown Jebel Ali. Exact site/title designation remains to confirm. This is not Palm Jebel Ali.
research.priceNote: Property Finder publishes AED 571,000 as its launch guide. This does not establish available stock or a current quotation for every apartment type.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder lists alternatives: 10% booking/40% construction/50% handover, or 10%/30%/60%. The displayed stages use the first option only; select the applicable signed unit schedule before relying on dates or amounts.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder forecasts Q1 2028, with January 2028 and a 16 January timeline. Older broker material still uses Q4 2026. No current primary contractual date or actual completion was verified.
unresolved: Confirm live unit availability, current price, contractual completion, payment option/dates, approved service charges, parking and furnishing. Portal sold-out status does not settle resale availability.
Brochure is multi-project: Arian pages 33–38 only. Other projects’ areas and amenities are excluded. Published totals include balcony space; no independent net-interior measurement is implied.
Marketing describes freehold residential space in JAFZA, but selected title/tenure and exact plot require primary contractual confirmation. Images remain illustrative.
